paragraphs.source_en: Nevertheless, through the innovative technique of simul taneously observing thousands of galaxies with wide-field-of-view tele scopes, the teams were able to find nearly four dozen type Ia supernovae at various distances from earth. After painstakingly determining the dis tance and recessional velocities of each, both groups came to a totally unexpected conclusion: ever since the universe was about 7 billion years old, its expansion rate has not been decelerating. Instead, the expansion rate has been speeding up.
